items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Kenny Clarke and I, practically the same age bracket... I used to give my Kenny my key to the Y... We were trying to do something to bring these kids along and to try to help them, because we were already established

ctx.x: Cozy Cole and Gene Krupa had a school.
Yes, of course. A lot of guys owe Cozy a lot. You take the Philly Joes, you take Max - I couldn't be here, and Kenny Clarke is gone.
Philly Joe Jones and then Max Roach, who's a master
